compatible struct that binary layout is fixed to the layout of .NET 10 or later(int offsetMinutes, long utcTicks).
is serialized as its memory layout but it is different by runtime(.NET 9 or lower is (short offsetMinutes, long utcTicks), Unity is (long utcTicks, short offsetMinutes)). If use this type instead of , the binary is same in all runtimes and it is compatible with of .NET 10 or later.
In deserialize, the binary serialized by of .NET 9 or lower can also be read. The binary serialized by of Unity can not be read, use for it.

member.name: T:MemoryPack.SafeNullable`1
member.summary:
compatible struct that has no padding.
of unmanaged type is serialized as its memory layout(bool hasValue, padding, T value) and the padding is not initialized, so the binary of the same value is not always same and it may include the garbage of memory. This type is (T hasValue, T value) so there is no padding, the binary of the same value is always same.
When T is primitive type(int, long, double, bool, etc...) or enum, the binary is compatible with (the both can read each other). In other types(Guid, decimal, user-defined struct, etc...), the binary is NOT compatible with .
